t: This Fortress Trade 4" Roller Tray is a robust plastic paint tray designed for efficient paint loading and removal of excess paint. It features raised ridges that ensure even distribution onto 4" rollers, while the deep well holds ample paint for continuous work. Ideal for painters and decorators on various interior painting projects, its durable construction provides reliability on site. The tray is easy to clean, saving valuable time between jobs, and comes supplied with 3 x convenient tray inserts, making colour changes quicker and reducing clean-up.
